No election-night results report remains readable for any target election, so check 2 cannot decide. Check 3 pending (origin/wayback-data branch not found). Targeted pass 3 2026-10-02 (targeted3-A): no election changed. The eGov document center browse lists (center.egov?view=browse&eGov_searchDepartment=140 and 141) show posting dates: 'May 26, 2026 Election Night Reconciliation Form' dated 05/26/2026 (item 10175), while the runoff 'Unofficial Results' item 10174 is no longer listed (and returns HTTP 404); runoff precinct and official results are dated 06/18/2026. So no election-night results file survives to read. Check 4: one web search for Huntsville Item precinct results found no Walker County results page. Wayback main harvest targeted co.walker.tx.us only (no captures); no phase1/targeted/ folder for Walker; sweep pending. Targeted pass 4 2026-10-02 (targeted4-I): no election changed. Tried: (1) eGov stores each document at /egov/documents/<unix upload time>_<n>.pdf (item 10238 resolves to /egov/documents/1781808693_24638.pdf = 18 Jun 2026 18:51:33 GMT), so posting times are readable, but the removed runoff 'Unofficial Results' item 10174 also returns HTTP 404 at view=detail, and its file name cannot be known without probing. Item 10175 'May 26, 2026 Election Night Reconciliation Form' resolves to /egov/documents/1779845954_50967.pdf (Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 01:39:14 GMT = 8:39 PM CDT election night), a one-page RICOH scan of the reconciliation form, not results; it shows only that the office posted on election night, not what results were posted. The browse list (department 141) dates the 2024 files 04/06/2026 (re-uploads). (2) Check 4: four web searches; the City of Huntsville page 'November 5, 2024 Election and Voter's Information' links 'Unofficial Election Results' (DocumentCenter/View/23589, CreationDate Wed Nov 6 04:21:00 2024 UTC), which is the city's own one-page summary of its at-large council races with totals only ('Final Unofficial Results of Election Returns November 5, 2024, General Election At-Large Councilmembers'), not a Walker County file and no per-precinct numbers, so it decides nothing; no Huntsville Item or other page with Walker County per-precinct numbers was found. (3) wayback-data: no targeted archives or sweep for Walker (sweep pending); the main harvest of co.walker.tx.us has no election-night captures. Not on newtools.cira.state.tx.us (eGov site). Targeted pass 6 2026-10-03 (targeted6-D): no election changed. Tried: (1) wayback-data sweep (phase1/targeted/sweep/Walker): zero versions for all three elections (runoff CDX timed out; Walker is in the sweep rerun, still running at the end of this pass). (2) Check 4: Huntsville Item date-filtered RSS search (hashes 484dfca6, 1b11e32c, b5ad52eb) lists only 'Final Unofficial results released in Walker County' (published 2024-11-05T18:41:00-06:00, before polls closed, 175 words, no table, hash d874831d), 'Results for Walker County Primaries in March 3 election' (2026-03-04T10:41:00-06:00, after election night; body is paywall-encoded and was not decoded, hash 21dc2d01) and the runoff story at 2026-05-27 09:23 CDT (after election night). Three web searches (one shared across counties, recorded) found no Walker County party website and no GitHub or civic scrape. No per-precinct candidate votes with an election-night time found.
